about: The language library's registry. Shelves, and one entry per text: kept (aboard true, written by scripts/fetch_library.py with the text's folder) or pinned by name and version only (aboard false, never copied). Never in specs/specs.json. See README.md.

shelves.title: Python
shelves.about: The Python documentation, kept as the publisher's plain-text build for each version a transcoding names and the current release.

shelves.title: ECMAScript
shelves.about: ECMA-262 for each edition, under Ecma International's alternative copyright notice; its conformance tests are pinned.

shelves.title: Go
shelves.about: The Go Programming Language Specification for each release.

shelves.title: Rust
shelves.about: The Rust Reference and the FLS for each release; neither claims to be complete.

shelves.title: JSON
shelves.about: RFC 8259, kept whole and served only as the publisher's own file.

shelves.title: Unicode
shelves.about: The Unicode Character Database's data files, kept whole; the core specification is pinned, not kept.

shelves.title: IEEE 754
shelves.about: Floating-point arithmetic: sold, all rights reserved, so pinned by name and version only.
